scope: Build rows from outer hosts with their original rigid rider groups. Use enclosing rectangles for curved host outlines in candidate construction. Expand and validate both stock and shared cuts against the original parts.
pilot: Repeat the same four development jobs, both kerfs and three seeds, 60 s per arm. Require 72 valid original layouts and all eight material changes <=+1% before running the complete comparison.
confirmation: Separate repeat of all 234 original cases with all inputs fixed, >=10% cut savings separately per kerf and every job within +1% material of matched ordinary runs.
